snippet.title: I Hate This Place | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
💥 I HATE THIS PLACE COMES NOVEMBER 7TH! 💥

Check your calendars and book your stay for THIS November in the most f**ed-up place in the world with twisted monsters and warped reality - breakfasts not included. 💀

Inspired by Skybound’s Eisner award-nominated comic book series created by writer Kyle Starks and artist Artyom Topilin, I Hate This Place plunges players deep into a supernatural world where the rules of reality come undone.

Wishlist Now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604490/I_Hate_This_Place/

You can also follow us on Social Media to stay up-to-date with all the latest IHTP news!
X/Twitter - https://x.com/BMGhorrors
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/people/Broken-Mirror-Games/61576569670277/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/bmghorrors/
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@brokenmirrorgame

Music:
“K.I.T.T. Vs. K.A.R.R” – composer: Ilan Pustopetski
Published by: Artlist Original Music

“The Hollows'' – composer: TRYHUBOVICH YAUHENI
Published by: TRYHUBOVICH YAUHENI
